description: Active benchmark manifest for the expanded Idea V2 task-first suite. Active cases: 328; includes F2 skill, F3 Tool/MCP, F1 memory, and Tier 2/3 complex persistent-poisoning cases.

v2_skill_runtime.note: Curated active F2 skill runtime suite: 84 cases. Post-review composition is 17 direct baseline cases plus 67 indirect/multi-stage persistence cases; obsolete reference and staging case trees are not runnable and have been removed.

v2_tool_mcp_runtime.note: Tool / MCP poisoning (Tier 1 F3). Active F3 cases include the original persistent-core cases plus task-first expansion variants through case_070.

F1_memory_runtime.note: Tier 1 memory poisoning suite normalized from runs/archive/legacy_v2_memory_evolution.zip. Selected source case groups are made standalone with Idea V2 metadata and clean controls.

T2_memory_to_skill.note: Tier 2 Memory-to-Skill complex cases generated from the task-first expansion matrix.

T3_subagent_poisoning.note: Tier 3 subagent and delegation poisoning complex cases.

T3_compaction_resume_poisoning.note: Tier 3 compaction and resume poisoning complex cases.

T3_shared_artifact_supply_chain.note: Additional complex shared-artifact supply-chain cases identified during taxonomy expansion.

reporting_views.note: The full active manifest remains runnable. Main ASR reporting can include every non-excluded hard-trace active case; reporting_track stratifies core, extended, and exploratory cases for paper tables, appendices, and case-study sections. The frozen planned/design-time case scope is exactly the 328 cases registered in this manifest. Realized conditional ASR uses only ASR-eligible N0-N5b scored attack rows; N-1 is accounted separately.
